item.title: New Zealand mosque shooter always planned to admit his crimes, his former lawyers tell appeals court
item.description: WELLINGTON, New Zealand (AP) — Brenton Tarrant, 35, was sentenced to life in prison without a chance of parole after pleading guilty to terrorism, murder and attempted murder for his hate-fueled massacre of worshippers including children at two Christchurch mosques during Friday prayers in 2019.
